parsed.title: REACTOR OVERHEATING
parsed.body:
All [intruder] in each [corridorNWSE], [corridorEW], and [corridorNESW] move.
Then, all [intruder] in every Room move.

If a [malfunction] is in the Cooling System
Room or the Reactor Room, Activate
the Autodestruction Procedure.
Then, place a [malfunction] in each of these Rooms.

Reshuffle the Event deck.
confidentlyVisible: All typography is upright in the file.

The three outlined corridor glyphs run NW–SE, east–west, and NE–SW from left to right.
Two white cog-shaped glyphs match the canonical malfunction icon.
Rules text is divided across three bordered panels.
